document.abstract: The Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers (SCTE), now in its 42nd year of incorporation, is the largest cable-centric professional association in the U.S. SCTE's mission is to provide professional development, information, and standards to more than 13,000 individual members, over 160 standards-member organizations, and to the industry that it serves.
